objective: Implement the authoritative Day-1 vendor accounting, bills, credits, AP subledger, aging inputs, disbursement evidence, and Accounting handoff defined by ACC.AP.CONTRACT.1.
dependencies: PAY.1-3.ACCEL integration or explicit migration-free disposition for slot 3
non_dependency_context: PUR.1 is not required for generic/non-PO AP; its future adapter consumes only accepted Purchasing public facts

repository.name: ACP-Enterprise
repository.start_rule: fetch origin, confirm dependencies and one Alembic head, then create an isolated worktree

prohibited_paths: backend/app/accounting/** except consumption of accepted public contracts
persistence_owner: Accounts Payable owns accounting vendors and source/Purchasing mappings, vendor bills/revisions/lines, duplicate review evidence, credits and applications, AP subledger entries, disbursement evidence/applications, reconciliation exceptions, and Accounting posting receipts.

migration.parent_rule: descend from the actual single authoritative head after slots 1 through 3 are integrated or explicitly migration-free
migration.collision_rule: stop for overlapping DDL, published revision, incompatible Accounting/Purchasing semantics, data rewrite, or migration identity collision

api_scope: Company-scoped accounting vendor create/read/archive and Purchasing mapping
vendor bill draft/submit/approve/read and duplicate review
verified disbursement record/apply/reverse without money initiation
AP open items, aging inputs, control reconciliation, and posting receipt status
required_invariants: one AP obligation per approved bill revision and no GL-posted state without a Core posting receipt
posted evidence is append-only and corrections are compensating
open items derive from AP subledger evidence and reconcile to AP control
duplicate vendor bill identity fails closed unless independently reviewed under policy
credits and disbursements cannot over-apply or cross vendor, Company, or currency
receipt, PO, Inventory movement, bill, liability, and disbursement remain distinct facts
closed periods reject approval/posting handoff and correction
idempotent replay returns the original result and contradictory replay conflicts
preparer/approver, duplicate override, disbursement, and reconciliation SOD is record-level
missing financial evidence is never treated as zero
validation: vendor identity/source mapping, archive, Company isolation, and restricted-data tests
bill lifecycle, immutable revision, totals, currency, period, and account-mapping tests
hard/possible duplicate, normalization, concurrent duplicate, override, and SOD tests
vendor credit application/unapplication, correction, reversal, and over-application tests
AP subledger replay, open-item, aging-input, and AP-control reconciliation tests
non-PO and fake Purchasing PO/receipt fact contract tests without Purchasing table access
verified disbursement record/application/reversal and unknown-outcome tests without money initiation
Accounting posting receipt, failure, replay, audit, and atomic Business Event tests
optimistic concurrency, row-lock, rollback, Company/Branch, permission-negative, and API security tests
responsive frontend AP workflow, accessibility, API contract, and authorization tests
affected Accounting Core, Invoicing, Payments contract, Inventory, authorization, audit, and event regressions
Ruff, MyPy, ESLint, TypeScript typecheck, frontend production build, git diff --check, and focused secret/private-key scan
fresh Alembic upgrade, revision downgrade/re-upgrade, drift detection, and exactly one head

environment_gates.finance: Finance mappings, policies, SOD identities, and control review required before activation
environment_gates.cutover: separate final owner and independent Finance approval required

completion: exact-boundary implementation and comprehensive validation pass
Finance inputs are evidenced or their fail-closed activation gates remain explicit
one migration descends from the then-current single authoritative head
one exact-boundary commit is normally pushed with local/remote synchronized and clean
ACC.POST.1 receives stable accepted AP event contracts
